question: Who among the following is famously called the Iron Lady of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indira Gandhi is known as the **"Iron Lady of India"** and she was the **first women Prime Minister of India**.
 
• First Rajya Sabha member to become the PM.
 
• Indira Gandhi born was on 19th November 1917 in Allahabad in Uttar Pradesh and her birthday is celebrated as **'National Integration Day.**
 
• The first woman got **Bharat Ratna** in **1971**.
 
• Longest Serving Chairperson ;of Planning Commission.
 
• She raised the slogan **'Garibi Hatao' (Remove Poverty).**
 
• She was the PM who **Nationalised 14 banks** in 1969 and 6 banks in 1980.
 
• India's 'Iron Lady' Indira Gandhi was assassinated on the morning of **31 October 1984.**
 
• The murder was carried out by his 'Sikh bodyguards' Satwant Singh and Beant Singh.
 
• This assassination took place after **'Operation Blue Star**' carried out by the Indian Army at the behest of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• Resting place - **Shaktisthal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mary Kom-**

 
 
• Mary Kom is an Indian Olympic **boxer**.
 
• Mary Kom was born in Kangathei village, Moirang Lamkhai in the Churachandpur district of rural **Manipur** in India.
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in **2020**.
 
• She became the first Indian female boxer to win a gold medal in the **Asian Games in 2014** at Incheon, South Korea, and is the first Indian female boxer to win gold at the **2018 Commonwealth Games.**
 
 
 
• **Deepika Padukone-**
 
 
• Deepika Padukone is an **Indian film actress**.
 
• She is the founder of the **"Live Love Laugh Foundation"**, which creates awareness of mental health in India.
 
• First Bollywood movie of Deepika Padukone is **"Om shanti om".**
 
 
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar-**
 
 
• She was an Indian **playback singer** and music director.
 
• She was honored with The **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** in **1989**.
 
• She was awarded the **Bharat Ratna, (2001)** India's highest civilian honor.
 
• Mangeshkar was born in **Indore** on **28 September 1929.**
 
• She breathed her last at Breach Candy Hospital, Mumbai on **6 February 2022 **(Sunday), at the age of **92.**
